people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: But the magicians did the same thing by their magic arts, and they also brought frogs up onto the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: And the magicians did in like manner with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
